detail: Sumitomo Corporation has acquired a 49% equity shareholding in Clean Solar Power (Baniyana) Private Limited, a subsidiary of HSEPL, which forms part of Hero Future Energies, the renewable energy business arm of the Hero Group. Khaitan & Co advised Sumitomo Corporation on this acquisition. The Firm was involved in negotiating, drafting, and reviewing transaction documents; conducting legal due diligence on the Target Company and the Project; and assisting with the execution of transaction documents.
